taskRules.target: Sort notes by onset, then pitch, then ID. From index floor(n/2), take the first note whose pitch/onset address is unique and whose edited result neither collides with another note address nor leaves MIDI range 0-127. Instances sharing a window choose in instance order; a later instance skips notes already targeted.
taskRules.velocity: Transcriptions carry placeholder velocity 64, so real windows receive synthetic dynamics from r01-pilot-velocity-v1: per-work base 64-84, phrase depth 6-12 and phase 0-7 quarters; per note, beat accent +6 (+4 more on a four-quarter downbeat) within 1/16 quarter of a beat, +2 within 1/16 of an off-beat, a triangular eight-quarter phrase swell, register emphasis round((pitch - median pitch) / 6) clamped to +/-4, and jitter -5..5; rounded and clamped to 20-120. They are not recovered performance dynamics.
taskRules.shiftRange: The first of [4,6), [6,8), [8,10), [10,12) containing at least two onsets whose shifted result has no pitch/onset collision.
taskRules.editVelocity: 91, or 37 if the target velocity is already 91.
taskRules.synthetic: Seeded SHA-256 draws from r01-pilot-synthetic-v1; spreads are even 1/512 cells so halving stays on the grid.

source.timingPolicy: exact source values and spellings; no quantization

limits: Development stage: works A-C and this synthetic seed may be reused and tuned; results support design iteration only.
Real-source windows are transcriptions; their velocities are seeded synthetic dynamics over placeholder 64, not recovered performance dynamics or musical intent.
Source tasks exclude current-document and Producer Pal arms: no annotation adapter or sidecar is supplied (pilot draft 2, review answer 3).
Cards, shared instructions, scope text and response contracts are the E358 versions; only requests, inputs and oracles are new.
Common performed scoring normalizes once at 1/512; IDs/order are not cross-format scored. Source scoring is exact.
Native Producer Pal parsing is tolerant; semantic pass does not establish canonical or strictly valid syntax.
Cell order is build order; trial order comes from the pilot runner plan.
